## Label
Immediately after submitting your Pull request make sure to post `/patch` as a comment. This adds the `patch` label and enable checks to continue.
If check fails before you add the label, you can restart the check by adding and removing the `patch` label manually

## Checklist before your work can be merged
- [ ] I have installed the branch locally
- [ ] I have ensured tested that my changes doesn't cause any errors by executing the `mmadeploy ...` command (without `--test`, and `--update`)
- [ ] I have not added/removed any modules or features.
- [ ] I've added the `patch` label to my PR!
